pages.text: $(bold)How to obtain$():$(li)Get $(bold)Molten Dragonsteel (Fire)$() by smelting Dragonsteel (Fire) Ingots in the Smeltery (made from Ice and Fire's $(bold)Fire Dragon$() materials)$(li)At the Casting Table, pour $(bold)90 mB$() of Molten Dragonsteel (Fire) (1 ingot) to make Dragonsteel (Fire) material$(br2)Tier: $(bold)T3$().

$(bold)Innate traits$():$(li)$(l:traits/trait_dragonsteel_fire)Dragonsteel Fire$(): on hit, triggers a small explosion that ignites the target and nearby enemies; the burning lasts longer with each level$(br2)The three dragonsteel variants - Dragonsteel Fire / Dragonsteel Ice / Dragonsteel Lightning - are the classic offensive materials, matched to Fire, Ice and Lightning dragons respectively.
